RwlsRawT.source: manifest:primary_16.combination.R_wls rounded to 21 decimals (ungrouped, for S columns)

RmpRawT.source: manifest:primary_16.combination.R_mp rounded to 21 decimals (ungrouped, for S columns)

RbayesRawT.source: manifest:primary_16.combination.R_bayes rounded to 21 decimals (ungrouped, for S columns)

dSegNineWls.source: derived: sensitivity_17 minus primary_16 WLS center, in 1e-18

tidalChiTheory.source: frozen seg9 JSON: synthesis.goodness_of_fit.theory.chi2_red (fixed A=-1 template)

tidalShiftEmpE.source: derived: empirical minus raw Bayesian center shift from the frozen seg9 JSON, in 1e-18; the larger of the two model shifts adopted for the uncertainty item

tidalShiftAltE.source: derived: empirical-minus-raw Bayesian center shift of the second tide model (DE421 + FES2022) from clock_ratio/tidal_new_model_compare.json, in 1e-18 (sign opposite to the ETideLoad4.5 template)

tidalChiAlt.source: derived: reduced chi-square of the A=-0.54 scenario with the second tide model (DE421 + FES2022) from clock_ratio/tidal_new_model_compare.json, 16 segments

tidalCorrTotal.source: derived: 17-segment Pearson r of y_i vs segment-mean full tide (tidal_solid_only_compare.json)

tidalCorrSolid.source: derived: 17-segment Pearson r of y_i vs segment-mean solid tide only (tidal_solid_only_compare.json)

nSegNine.source: derived: sensitivity_17.total_samples minus primary_16.total_samples (the number of seconds carried by segment 9)

uSrE.source: curated: USTC Sr1 systematic uncertainty 9.2e-19 (Jia et al. 2026, Metrologia 63, 025002), adopted as 0.92e-18

uYbE.source: curated (user-confirmed): Wuhan Yb lattice-clock published systematic uncertainty 1.3e-18 (Zhu et al., arXiv:2606.10514); resolves the internal 1.1e-18 vs published 1.3e-18 conflict in favor of the published evaluation

uLinkE.source: curated upper bound: experiment-side budget lists the fiber transfer as < 1e-19 (experiment materials; .omo/drafts/experiment-facts.md); adopted as 0.1e-18

uCombE.source: curated upper bound: experiment-side budget lists the comb transfer as < 1e-19 (experiment materials; .omo/drafts/experiment-facts.md); adopted as 0.1e-18

uTidalE.source: the larger of the two independent tide-model center shifts: frozen audit layer empirical-shift 0.8479e-18 (ETideLoad4.5 template) vs 0.2132e-18 (DE421+FES2022 template, opposite sign); carried as the time-varying-redshift uncertainty item

dWVal.source: curated: leveled geopotential difference 280.042 m^2/s^2 (experiment-side leveling report); cross-checked by the GNSS + EGM2008 geoid calibration (280.60 +/- 2.558 m^2/s^2, delta_w_alt), consistent within uncertainties

dWUnc.source: curated: leveling uncertainty +/- 0.085 m^2/s^2 (experiment-side leveling report)

dWAlt.source: curated: GNSS + EGM2008 geoid-model calibration of the geopotential difference (independent check, experiment-side leveling report)

dWAltUnc.source: curated: uncertainty of the GNSS + EGM2008 geoid calibration (experiment-side leveling report)

refNistV.source: literature: Aeppli et al. 2026, Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 033201 (arXiv:2512.21428)

refNistU.source: literature: Aeppli et al. 2026 (as above), quoted uncertainty digits

refNistE.source: literature: Aeppli et al. 2026 quoted uncertainty, in 1e-18

refEuV.source: literature: Pizzocaro et al. 2026, Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033250 (arXiv:2604.27963)

refEuU.source: literature: Pizzocaro et al. 2026 (as above), quoted uncertainty digits

refEuE.source: literature: Pizzocaro et al. 2026 quoted uncertainty, in 1e-18

fibreKm.source: experiment materials (link documentation): single-pass fiber length

roundKm.source: experiment materials (link documentation): loop-back round-trip length

siteKm.source: experiment materials (link documentation): separation of the two sites

levelKm.source: experiment-side leveling report: leveling line length

nStages.source: experiment materials: number of measurement stages

refSameCampusU.source: literature: Aeppli et al. 2026 (PRL 137, 033201): best same-campus (NIST-JILA, 3.6 km link) cross-species ratio uncertainty, as quoted

refSameCampusKm.source: literature: Aeppli et al. 2026 (as above): phase-stabilized fiber link length of the NIST-JILA campus comparison

refEuBestU.source: literature: Pizzocaro et al. 2026 (Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033250; arXiv:2604.27963): best ratio in the European fiber network campaign

refPtbTransportableU.source: literature: Vishwakarma et al. 2026 (arXiv:2608.01916): Yb+/Sr ratio uncertainty with a transportable clock at PTB

baconE.source: literature: Beloy et al. 2021 (Nature 591, 564): BACON campus network measured frequency ratios with fractional uncertainties at or below 8e-18

nemitzU.source: literature: Nemitz et al. 2016 (Nat. Photon. 10, 258): Yb/Sr ratio with 5e-17 uncertainty at 150 s averaging time

refVlbiKm.source: literature: Pizzocaro et al. 2021 (Nature Physics 17, 223-227): VLBI comparison of two optical clocks separated by about 9000 km

refLisdatKm.source: literature: Lisdat et al. 2016 (Nature Communications 7, 12443): Paris-Braunschweig Sr-Sr comparison over 1415 km of telecom fiber

fRepMHz.source: clock/params.json (FREF=1e7, DIV20=20): comb repetition rate, MHz

fFifteenTHz.source: clock/params.json: N1550_WH x f_rep = 966996 x 200 MHz; the 1550 nm transfer frequency used to convert the beat to fractional units

deltaGV.source: clock/params.json DELTA_G = -3.116e-15: static gravitational-redshift correction applied in the ratio inversion

uSubsystemBound.source: experiment materials: upper bound quoted for the fiber-link and comb transfer subsystems (<1e-19 each)

levelMm.source: experiment-side leveling report: per-kilometer misclosure of the leveling line (first-order limit 0.45 mm)

refThreshold.source: literature: Dimarcq et al. 2024 (Metrologia 61, 012001), mandatory criterion I.2: required agreement level of frequency-ratio comparisons

selfEvalBound.source: author-supplied abstract statement (2026-10-09): bound quoted for self-evaluated uncertainties of current optical clocks; consistent with the introduction citations (lattice and single-ion clocks at or below 1e-18: arnold2026lu, zhang2026ca)

refLisdatU.source: literature: Lisdat et al. 2016 (Nature Communications 7, 12443): reported Sr-Sr ratio uncertainty over 1415 km of fiber

euNClocks.source: literature: Pizzocaro et al. 2026: number of optical clocks in the European fiber-network campaign

euNInstitutes.source: literature: Pizzocaro et al. 2026: number of participating institutes

lindvallNClocks.source: literature: Lindvall et al. 2025 (Optica 12, 843): number of optical clocks in coordinated comparisons

lindvallNCountries.source: literature: Lindvall et al. 2025: number of countries

lindvallNRatios.source: literature: Lindvall et al. 2025: number of optical frequency ratios reported

schioppoKm.source: literature: Schioppo et al. 2022 (Nature Communications 13, 212): metrological fiber link network length

chenKm.source: literature: Chen et al. 2026 (Light: Science & Applications 15, 276): field-deployed fiber link length

claimDate.source: the claim date of the first-report statement; user-confirmed timing

uTotalE.source: derived: quadrature of the budget components (this pipeline)

uTotalShort.source: derived: quadrature of the budget components, 2 significant figures

RheadlineUnc.source: derived: total standard uncertainty (fractional) multiplied by the ratio value, as the parenthesized digits on the last two decimals of the headline value

dVsNistE.source: derived: R_bayes minus the NIST-JILA reference, in 1e-18

dVsEuE.source: derived: R_bayes minus the European-network reference, in 1e-18
